newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiichi Kyoken, Gakuikusha to be suspended - JSDA.
newsitem.headline: Daiichi Kyoken, Gakuikusha to be suspended - JSDA.

text.p: Shares of Daiichi Kyoken Co Ltd and Gakuikusha Corp are to be temporarily suspended on the over-the-counter (OTC) market, Japan's Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Friday.
The suspension was due to the fact the information could affect investors' decision-making and the need for the JSDA to confirm the information, the association said.
Daiichi Kyoken, a Japanese operator of cram schools, later said that it had agreed to merge with Gakukikusha, which manages preparatory schools.
